propositions: The documentation link checker must validate relative Markdown links and images against a maintained repository boundary that includes docs, agent guides, infra runbooks, examples, and templates while excluding fixtures, prompts, and reviewer modules.
Relative link targets must resolve from their source directory and are permitted anywhere inside the repository but rejected if they escape repository bounds.
Query strings and fragments are stripped before file resolution; scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, fenced code blocks, inline code spans, and reference-style links are ignored.
Each validation finding must report repository-relative source path, line number, raw target, normalized target path, and failure reason in deterministic order.
The checker retains existing top-level docs index membership validation as a separate rule and replaces duplicate outbound-link parsers with a unified deterministic API.
Documentation policy must be updated to state the maintained source boundary, parser behavior, and exclusions.
